title: A toy call responds to volatility
hook: Two stated cases: explore the constant volatility in a no-dividend European option model.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the constant volatility in a no-dividend European option model affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Call, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the constant volatility in a no-dividend European option model in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy European call has Spot 100, Strike 100, rate 0.03, volatility Sigma 0.2, Time 1. Under the no-dividend constant-volatility Black-Scholes model, what price results?
